BiblicalUsage: Kebarah means a sieve, a sifter. Amos 9:9 says God will sift the house of Israel among all nations, like as corn is sifted in a sieve, yet shall not the least grain fall upon the earth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God's sieve keeps every grain: he shakes his people hard, but he loses none of them.
